players.product: Helios AI/HPC data-center campus (West Texas, 800 gross MW) leased to CoreWeave, plus Merlin / Caspian / Selene Texas development sites - ex-Bitcoin-mining site (Galaxy Power)

connects_to.relationship: Helios campus (West Texas) AI data-center capacity leased to CoreWeave - 800 gross MW across three phases (Phase I 133 MW critical IT delivered; Phase II 260 MW; Phase III 133 MW)

contracts.signal: Galaxy's 10-Q reports data center lease revenue of $18.9 million for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, attributable to the commencement of the CoreWeave Phase I lease agreement, and data center operator revenue of $5.8 million attributable to pass-through operating costs related to the CoreWeave lease; Galaxy recognized its first lease revenue from the segment in the second quarter. Helios has developed the first 133 MW of critical IT load for CoreWeave under the 15-year Lease Agreement entered into in April 2025, and the incremental 393 MW under the Phase II and Phase III leases is expected to be delivered starting in the second quarter of 2027.
contracts.units: 133 MW critical IT load developed; incremental 393 MW from Q2 2027
contracts.value: $18.9 million lease revenue and $5.8 million operator revenue (three and six months ended June 30, 2026)
